descByPlatform.flux: An extraordinarily detailed photorealistic fine-art photograph of a surreal scale-play scene: a tiny perfect miniature human figure (approximately 3 centimeters tall relative to the hand) sitting comfortably cross-legged in the center of a large adult human palm. The miniature figure wears a rich maroon cotton t-shirt with realistic fabric micro-texture at miniature scale, her arms folded across her chest in a tight defiant crossed posture, eyebrows pulled firmly together in a pronounced pout-furrowed expression — the perfect portrait of someone being adorably annoyed. The massive hand shows hyper-realistic adult skin — visible fine skin lines, natural pore texture, warm flesh tones, slightly curved fingers creating a natural cradle. The thumb and forefinger reach in gently to pinch the miniature figure's tiny cheek, exaggerating the pout endearingly. Background is deeply defocused (f/0.8 equivalent) revealing an urban nocturnal cityscape: distinct bokeh orbs in warm amber orange, traffic-light red, electric green, and cool blue creating a jewel-like dreamy constellation. Cinematic directional key light illuminates the hand-and-figure composition perfectly. Ultra-sharp miniature hair texture, 8K photorealistic rendering, 4:5 aspect ratio.
